scope: Extend R493 from semantic arrow pixels to every comparable pixel in the complete 11x11 held-arrow bounding box.

method.description: Parse all 11 rows of the recorded held-arrow glyph map. Compare the installed asset RGB against the mapped native topShadow, bottomShadow, face, and trough/context colors. Mask only C symbols, which identify cursor-overlay pixels outside the triangle in the reference capture.

result: All 112 non-cursor pixels in the complete held-arrow bounding box match the recorded SR10.4 map exactly, including all 41 visible trough/context positions. This strengthens R493's 71/71 semantic-pixel comparison and confirms the installed 15x15 asset places the 11x11 glyph correctly for this down-pressed state.
limits: The 9 cursor-overlay pixels were excluded because their underlying VUE pixels cannot be recovered from the captured image.
This compares a saved native SR10.4 capture/map with the installed asset; it is not a new live VM interaction.
It covers only the down-stepper held state. Other directions/states, an open GTK2 application, and human visual acceptance remain separate.
No VM input, theme/profile change, MAME setting change, or application restart occurred.
next: Retain the current down-pressed GTK2 asset. Continue I167 only with uncovered historical states and the outstanding GTK2 application review; do not alter arrow dimensions without a measured mismatch.
